# Hub and spoke: with a route_paths key in muxt.json, muxt generate writes the
# path helpers of every listed package into the package in the muxt.json
# directory, and the packages import it. A template names the package it links
# to: {{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}, its own included.

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a id="self" href="{{$.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a><a id="path" href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a><a id="route" href="{{$.Route.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a href="{{.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m"
	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestLinksCrossPackages(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	var paths m.TemplateRoutePaths = admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})

	if got, want := paths.Blog().GetArticle(7), "/article/7"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("paths.Blog().GetArticle(7) = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	for target, wants := range map[string][]string{
		"/admin":      {`id="self" href="/admin"`, `id="path" href="/article/42"`, `id="route" href="/article/42"`},
		"/article/42": {`href="/admin"`},
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
		if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", target, got, http.StatusOK)
		}
		for _, want := range wants {
			if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, want) {
				t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", target, body, want)
			}
		}
	}
}
